description: This file defines the implementation of an account entity service related to loans within the Fineract project. It includes methods for retrieving account keys, validating user-account mappings, and retrieving account numbers by ID, specifically for loan accounts.

classes.name: AccountEntityServiceForLoanImpl
classes.description: Implements account-related services for loan accounts, including validation and retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the constant key identifier for loan accounts.

methods.name: validateSelfUserAccountMapping
methods.description: Checks if the loan account with given ID is mapped to the current authenticated user; throws exception if not.

methods.name: retrieveAccountNumberByAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves account number associated with a loan account ID.
